metaDescription: Google Analytics is Google's free web and app analytics for traffic, user behaviour and conversions, with Analytics 360 for enterprises. See its features, pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Google Analytics measures how people find and use your websites and apps. It uses event-based tracking, with reports on acquisition, engagement and conversions, real-time reporting, and machine learning that surfaces insights and fills gaps in data you can observe.

The standard version is free and integrates with Google's advertising and publisher tools. Large enterprises can upgrade to Analytics 360, a paid version with higher limits for data collection, reporting, retention and BigQuery export, guaranteed data freshness and service-level agreements.

features.title: Event-based tracking
features.text: Measure user interactions across websites and apps with events.

features.title: Real-time reporting
features.text: Monitor activity on your site or app as it happens.

features.title: Acquisition and engagement
features.text: See where users come from and how they engage with your content.

features.title: Conversions and attribution
features.text: Track key actions, with data-driven attribution modelling.

features.title: Machine learning insights
features.text: Proactive insights and privacy-safe modelling for a fuller picture of the customer journey.

features.title: Google integrations
features.text: Connect to Google Ads and other Google tools, plus BigQuery export.

strengths: Free for businesses of every size.
Deep integration with Google Ads and other Google tools.
Analytics 360 is available for large enterprises with SLAs.
limitations: Data freshness isn't guaranteed on the free version.
The free version has lower limits for custom dimensions, metrics and audiences.
Funnel reporting is more basic than in Analytics 360.
Analytics 360 pricing isn't published; it's based on a base fee plus event volume.

pricing.summary: The standard version of Google Analytics is free. Analytics 360 is a paid contract with a fixed base fee that includes the first 25 million monthly events, plus a per-event fee above that.
